delivered: Updated actionStateBlocksProceed and adaptInboxRecord in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts so that an incident row with action_state 'pending' does not block proceed by default (adapting to canProceed: true), while still honoring an explicit can_proceed: false / canProceed: false from the BFF and keeping non-incident rows with action_state 'pending' at canProceed: false.

Updated HumanGateDetailPage in src/management/pages/oversight/HumanGateDetail.tsx to render '—' and never 'nan' when Persona or Summary has no value, and to omit mgmt.inbox.headerSubtitleFmt (empty required role label and decision type) in the header of an incident item.

Added unit and component tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/management.test.ts, src/management/pages/oversight/HumanGateDetail.test.tsx, and src/management/pages/oversight/HumanInboxPage.test.tsx using the exact real BFF projector incident row.
